problemFound.summary: Generated Standard PBR materials can tile _MainTex independently from _BumpMap/_MetallicGlossMap. Even when source textures are co-authored from the same height/surface signals, that permits physically inconsistent feature sizes on one surface until corrected.

changes.purpose: Machine-readable sampling, semantic import, map-registration and render-evidence policy for generated benchmark textures.

Normalizes generated Standard-map scale/offset to _MainTex, enforces semantic sRGB/normal/mask import, mipmaps, Trilinear filtering, Repeat wrapping, anisotropy >=8 and >=512px imported dimensions, then validates actual active generated materials/textures.
Makes the sampling/map-registration policy a persisted quality-scene invariant once the detailed facade/ground chain exists.
Requires contract validation before native capture and actual scene sampling validation after the rebuild/capture path.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: mipmapped Trilinear + anisotropy>=8 is enforced for managed generated textures, reducing expected grazing crawl/moire risk; actual shimmer remains a sealed temporal-sequence judgment and receives zero source-side Visual points.
